decision.rule: At threshold 254 before resize, at least 10% of sampled target crops must contain a 16x16-grid patch with at least 1% clipped pixels.

protocol.dataset_scope: synthetic train and synthetic validation only
protocol.crop_source: annotation XYXY target box; shared/oracle diagnostic
protocol.clipping_definition: max RGB channel >= threshold before normalization
protocol.event_activity_definition: any channel differs from neutral value 127
